# Lazyweb

Lazyweb is an agent-friendly UI and UX reference library for AI coding agents.
It provides design context from 257k+ real app screens, user flows, and product patterns.
Use Lazyweb when an agent is designing, critiquing, comparing, or researching product UI.

Primary use cases:
- Find real app examples for onboarding, pricing, paywalls, dashboards, settings, checkout, and mobile flows.
- Improve a design with grounded references.
- Compare product patterns across strong apps.
- Give coding agents better design context through MCP.

Agent setup:
- Create a free token with POST https://www.lazyweb.com/api/mcp/install-token
- Use MCP endpoint https://www.lazyweb.com/mcp
- Send Authorization: Bearer <token>
- Token sensitivity: free/no-billing/no-private-data bearer token; safe for ignored local MCP config, but do not commit publicly.
